nodes.label: MainServlet

nodes.label: JSONArrayImpl
nodes.description: Wrapper around org.json.JSONArray implementing Liferay's JSONArray interface.

nodes.label: JSONDeserializerImpl
nodes.description: JSON deserializer backed by PortalJsonParser (jodd-json), supporting transformers and path-based mapping.

nodes.label: JSONFactoryImpl
nodes.description: Default JSON factory producing JSON arrays/objects, serializers/deserializers, and XML-JSONML converters.

nodes.label: JSONObjectImpl
nodes.description: Wrapper around org.json.JSONObject implementing Liferay's JSONObject interface.

nodes.label: UnmodifiableJSONObjectImpl
nodes.description: Immutable variant of JSONObjectImpl returning null for all mutation operations.

nodes.label: JSONSerializerImpl
nodes.description: JSON serializer backed by org.jabsorb.JSONSerializer with support for deep serialization, transformers, and include/exclude filters.

nodes.description: Custom jodd-json JsonParser extension for portal JSON parsing.

nodes.label: LiferayJSONSerializer
nodes.description: Custom jabsorb JSONSerializer with Liferay-specific serialization support.

nodes.label: LiferayJSONDeserializationWhitelist
nodes.description: Whitelist controlling which classes are safe to deserialize via jabsorb.

nodes.label: EnumSerializer
nodes.description: Custom jabsorb serializer for Java enums.

nodes.label: LiferaySerializer
nodes.description: Custom jabsorb serializer for Liferay-specific types.

nodes.description: Struts-based request processor invoked by MainServlet for doGet/doPost routing.

nodes.label: EncryptedServletRequest
nodes.description: HTTP request wrapper that decrypts parameters using company encryption keys.
